_note: DEMO DATA. Written for the sample businesses; shown in the UI as 'Sample review (demo data)'. Not real customer reviews.

coolair-hvac.text: Catches the calls we used to miss while on roofs. Summaries land as texts within a minute. Had to tune the emergency questions in week one.
Quotes from saved line items on my phone instead of at night on paper. The QuickBooks sync took one afternoon to set up.

joes-coffee.text: Students swap shifts in the app and I approve with one tap. Rebuilding the semester schedule went from hours to about 30 minutes.
The 2-5pm student offer brought people in, but writing a good message still takes me a few tries.
Free and does the job for scheduling Instagram posts. Support is basically help articles.

greenleaf.text: Customers request quotes online and approve with one tap. I answer spring requests same day now instead of next week.
